agents.name: context-manager
responsibilities: Prepare the bounded context slice for the task domain
Never truncate task text, restrictions or selected skills; fail when the budget is exceeded

agents.name: architect
responsibilities: Own root workspace wiring: package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml and .npmrc
Enforce monorepo boundaries and the shared package policy
Run bootstrap before application domains write

agents.name: backend
responsibilities: Implement Go API changes under apps/api following the four-layer structure
Keep docs/api/openapi.yaml in sync with routes
Preserve tenancy, RBAC and observability guarantees

agents.name: backoffice
responsibilities: Implement the Next.js 16 backoffice under apps/backoffice, the provider portal under apps/provider-portal and the sales portal under apps/sales-portal
Consume only typed contracts that exist in docs/api/openapi.yaml; never invent endpoints
Deliver responsive, accessible enterprise UX without native alert/confirm/prompt

agents.name: n8n
responsibilities: Build deterministic, idempotent, observable n8n workflows under n8n/ (domain currently disabled: no n8n/ directory)

agents.name: infra
responsibilities: Maintain infra/ and .github/ preserving environment isolation, secrets policy and rollback
Keep CI workflows reproducible and least-privilege

agents.name: tester
responsibilities: Add or extend automated tests for the changed behavior after the implementer finishes
Report coverage gaps instead of weakening assertions
contextSources: existing test suites of the domain

agents.name: reviewer
responsibilities: Independent read-only review of the implementers' changes
Return failed with actionable findings; never edit files
Return files as []; cite reviewed files in decisions/verification as path:line; risks only for actionable findings (status failed), non-blocking observations go in decisions
verification: findings reference concrete files and lines

agents.name: security-auditor
responsibilities: Independent read-only audit of tenancy isolation, authorization, RBAC and secret handling
Return failed for any actionable finding; never edit files
Return files as []; cite audited files in decisions/verification as path:line; risks only for actionable findings (status failed), non-blocking observations go in decisions
verification: no unresolved auth, tenancy or secret findings

agents.name: documentation
responsibilities: Keep docs/ and root Markdown aligned with implemented behavior
Follow the Markdown quality skill

agents.name: logger
responsibilities: Record the compact lifecycle outcome after all gates
Deterministic node: writes the completion handoff only

agents.name: verifier
responsibilities: Independent final verification: execute the domain gates declared in domains.json
Fail closed on any non-zero gate exit code
